Agent response: Thanks for letting us know about the trouble you’ve had. We’re so sorry for the inconvenience! Remember, Whipshots are unique and do require some finesse, so please be sure to always give the can a vigorous, upside-down 'Cardi-shake' to drop the whip before dispensing the product. Also, remember not to refrigerate! The following directions need to be followed carefully and for at least 20+ seconds at a time, repeating if necessary before moving to the next step: - When you slap it, be sure it’s held directly upside down and slap the can very firmly against your palm until you feel the Whipshots ‘drop’ as it breaks away from the inside lining of the can. Note: If you don’t wait until the product ‘drops’ in this step, it won't work. Please be sure to ‘slap it’ on your palm until it drops, then move on to step 2. - When you shake it, shake upside-down until you hear it moving up and down consistently. This takes time, not just a couple of shakes. - Once the above occurs, you’re ready to Whip! I hope you find this helpful. Let me know if you have any other questions, and I’ll be here.

- When you shake it, shake upside-down until you hear it moving up and down consistently. This takes time, not just a couple of shakes.
- Once the above occurs, you’re ready to Whip!
